strings.jp:
虫ケラが!
死にたくなければそこをどきな!
strings.en:
Bug!
Move if ya don't wanna die!

strings.jp: 鴨がネギ背負って来たぜ!
strings.en:
A sitting duck just walked
right up to us!

strings.jp: うわぁぁぁ!　お、親分…

おっと、俺様ともあろう者が
思わず本気になっちまったぜ…
strings.en:
Whoops, the great me went
all out without meanin' to...

strings.jp: やっぱりダメですかい…
strings.en:
Guess it's no good
after all...

strings.jp:
雑魚じゃ何匹来たって
同じだって分からねぇのか?
strings.en:
Small fry are small fry, no
matter how many! Get it?
